environment.description: EKS pod deployed to subnet subnet-0x7b3c (10.0.128.0/24) in VPC vpc-0def456. Route table rtb-0cc891 has local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and NO other routes — specifically no NAT gateway, no internet gateway, no VPC peering, and no transit gateway attachment. VPC endpoint policy on the Kafka interface endpoint (vpce-0ab12cd) restricts produce operations to service account stream-processor-sa via condition key aws:PrincipalTag/team=platform-infra. DNS resolution is handled by Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint within the VPC. Security group sg-0def789 egress rules: allow TCP 9092 to pl-kafka (prefix list for Kafka broker ENIs), allow TCP 5432 to sg-0pg123 (RDS security group), deny all other outbound. No VPC flow log exceptions configured.

config.route_table: rtb-0cc891: local only (10.0.0.0/16 -> local), no NAT/IGW/TGW
config.security_group_egress: TCP 9092 to pl-kafka, TCP 5432 to sg-0pg123, implicit deny all
config.network_policy: Calico: egress allow to kafka-brokers.internal:9092 and postgres.internal:5432 only
config.dns: Route53 Resolver inbound, no external resolution
